sources.title: Why the Broncos drafted DT Tyler Onyedim
sources.description: After a small trade back that netted them an extra 6th round pick, the Denver Broncos made their first (and only so far) selection of the 2026 NFL Draft when they selected Texas A&M defensive tackle Tyler Onyedim. He is a 6-3, 292-pound defensive lineman with 34-inch arms, and profiles as a one-gap penetrator for […]
